home.name: tilted cover and a contents strip of six pictograms
home.js: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#home .hero__title')).transform!=='none' && document.querySelectorAll('.bh-curr a[href^="#"]').length===6 && document.querySelectorAll('.bh-curr svg .bh-f').length>=20 && (document.querySelectorAll('.bh-piece').length===14 ? document.querySelector('.bh-board').getAttribute('role')==='group' && document.querySelectorAll('.bh-piece[tabindex="0"]').length===1 : document.querySelectorAll('#home .bh-plate svg').length===1)

about.name: circle in square, a block lead and shape badges

experience.name: stairs: numbered step squares, each job set in further

projects.name: stacked blocks of different widths on a blue band

education.name: rising triangle: each course card wider than the one above, on a red band
education.js: document.getElementById('education').dataset.bhKind==='rising triangle' && (document.querySelectorAll('.bh-piece').length===14 || document.querySelectorAll('#education .bh-plate svg').length===1) && getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('education')).backgroundColor==='rgb(200, 32, 26)' && (function(){var w=[].map.call(document.querySelectorAll('#education .edu__item'),function(n){return n.getBoundingClientRect().width;}); return w.length===4 && (document.documentElement.dataset.bhMode==='static' ? w[0]===w[3] : (w[0]+4<w[1] && w[1]+4<w[2] && w[2]+4<w[3]));})()

contact.name: night poster: every link a line with a circle on it
